findings.title: Do not hardcode the fallback API key.
findings.rationale:
Line 12 embeds a credential-shaped sk-live-... value in the repository. The sk-live- prefix also conflicts with the comment stating that this is a staging key. Read the fallback from a secret manager or a separate environment variable. If this value is real, revoke and rotate it before merge.

Proposed fix

if k := os.Getenv("SERVICE_API_KEY"); k != "" { return k }

-	return "sk-live-9f8c2b1a7d6e5f4c3b2a1908" +	return os.Getenv("SERVICE_API_STAGING_KEY")
